responsibility: Performs LRA’s post-spill pseudo coalescing pass to remove memory-memory and other redundant move instructions created by spilling. It groups spilled pseudos with nonintersecting live ranges, merges their live-range information, substitutes representative pseudos throughout affected RTL and live-in/live-out bitmaps, and deletes resulting no-op moves while preserving value-identity correctness for inheritance-related cases. The pass is deliberately restricted to safe spilled-pseudo coalescing to avoid destabilizing later LRA iterations.
